generally.en: The government has generally defended these policies by arguing that Singapore needs its stability.
generally.zh: 政府通常通过辩称新加坡需要稳定性来为这些政策辩护。

generally.en: Europeans had their own part of the city and generally enjoyed a higher social position.
generally.zh: 欧洲人有他们自己的城市部分，并且普遍享有较高的社会地位。

generally.en: Research on computer-assisted language learning has generally found that technology can produce positive learning outcomes.
generally.zh: 关于计算机辅助语言学习的研究普遍发现，科技可以产生积极的学习成果。

generally.en: I’m also going to be talking relatively generally, rather than going into specific prompts and exercises.
generally.zh: 我也将进行比较概括的探讨，而不是深入探讨具体的提示词和练习。

generally.en: Countries with strong institutions are generally better able to manage their wealth.
generally.zh: 拥有强大机构的国家通常能更好地管理其财富。

gesture.en: Yes. We often make the physical gesture of crossing our fingers for good luck.
gesture.zh: 是的。我们经常做出交叉手指的身体手势来祈求好运。

gesture.en: They follow pointing gestures. They look to humans for guidance when faced with a problem.
gesture.zh: 它们会跟随人类的手势。当遇到问题时，它们会向人类寻求指引。

gesture.en: It's a gesture for saying hello, or a way of telling a person to do something.
gesture.zh: 这是一个打招呼的手势，或者是一种指示某人做某事的方式。

gesture.en: Young people have used it in videos, comments, as a gesture, as a sort of catch-all response to almost anything.
gesture.zh: 年轻人会在视频里、评论区里用它，也会用一个手势来表示它，把它当作几乎可以回应任何事情的万能答案。

gesture.en: And finally, non-verbal cues are types of communication using facial expressions, hand gestures or tone of voice, rather than speech, to show your feelings.
gesture.zh: 最后，non-verbal cues（非言语线索）是指使用面部表情、手势或语调而不是言语来进行沟通，以表达你感受的交流方式。

general.en: OK then, let’s get right into it and talk about the next general election.
general.zh: 好了，让我们直接进入正题，聊聊接下来的大选。

general.en: The general feeling was that, as a society, we had moved past all that.
general.zh: 普遍的看法是，作为一个社会，我们已经超越了这一切。

general.en: It's how scientists form a consensus – meaning a general agreement – about the issue.
general.zh: 这就是科学家们如何就某个问题形成共识——意思是达成普遍一致的意见。

general.en: As a general rule, try to ask a question in one clear sentence.
general.zh: 作为一个一般规则，尽量用一个清晰的句子来提出问题。

general.en: So, there is a national election–or general election–which typically happens every five years.
general.zh: 所以，会有一次全国大选（或大选），通常每五年举行一次。

genetics.en: Twin studies use twins to investigate the roles of genetics and environment in human development.
genetics.zh: 双胞胎研究利用双胞胎来调查遗传和环境在人类发展中的作用。

genetics.en: It paved the way for modern genetics, ecology, and even parts of medicine.
genetics.zh: 它为现代遗传学、生态学甚至是部分医学铺平了道路。

genetics.en: For example, you could, via genetics, smell coriander or taste coriander differently.
genetics.zh: 例如，由于基因原因，你闻到香菜或品尝香菜的味道可能会有所不同。

genetics.en: Dana explains that how we taste or smell something can be different depending on our genetics.
genetics.zh: 达娜解释说，我们如何品尝或闻到某种东西，会根据我们的基因而有所不同。

genetics.en: Together evolution and genetics created the field now known as evolutionary biology.
genetics.zh: 进化论与遗传学结合在一起，催生了如今被称为进化生物学的领域。

generation.en: Rockefellers and Vanderbilts were admitted, as well as three generations of the Bush family.
generation.zh: 洛克菲勒家族和范德比尔特家族都被接纳了，布什家族的三代人也是如此。

generation.en: Saudi Arabia could adopt a different system that kept things in the same generation.
generation.zh: 沙特阿拉伯可以采用一种将权力保持在同一代人手中的不同体制。

generation.en: But with no direct heirs, all eyes turned, yet again, to the next generation.
generation.zh: 但由于没有直系继承人，所有人的目光又一次转向了下一代。

generation.en: Generational poverty, on the other hand, is passed down from one generation to the next.
generation.zh: 另一方面，代际贫困是从一代传给下一代的。

generation.en: In Europe, new universities opened their doors for a generation hungry for opportunity.
generation.zh: 在欧洲，新大学为渴望机会的一代人敞开了大门。

generate.en: This would require an unimaginable amount of energy—far beyond what humanity could ever generate.
generate.zh: 这将需要难以想象的巨大能量——远远超过人类所能产生的能量。

generate.en: You can Google almost anything, or AI can generate explanations in seconds.
generate.zh: 你几乎可以谷歌搜索任何东西，或者让AI在几秒钟内生成解释。

generate.en: It would just generate random IELTS style writing prompts every day, and I made it using Claude.
generate.zh: 它每天只会生成随机的雅思风格写作提示，而我是用Claude制作的。

generate.en: A half-dog, half-Jesus photo is generated by AI and posted online.
generate.zh: 一张半狗半耶稣的照片由 AI 生成并发布在网上。

generate.en: And not every AI application will generate a profit.
generate.zh: 并非每个AI应用都能产生利润。

geology.en: He spent more than 20 years studying plants, animals, fossils, geology, and as many scientific papers as possible.
geology.zh: 他花了20多年的时间研究植物、动物、化石、地质学，以及尽可能多的科学论文。

geology.en: So, imagine that you have a 10,000-year-long civilisation, which is a blink of the eye for geology – that's too short to really create a lot of fossils.
geology.zh: 所以，想象一下你有一个存在了1万年的文明，这在地址学上只是眨眼的一瞬间——这太短暂了，根本无法创造出大量的化石。

gently.en: When food is simmering, it's cooking at a temperature slightly below boiling so that it bubbles gently.
gently.zh: 当食物在慢炖（simmering）时，它在略低于沸点的温度下烹饪，以便轻轻冒泡。

gently.en: Now, that version of events was, to put it gently, implausible.
gently.zh: 说得委婉一点，这个版本的说法实在难以令人信服。

gently.en: Instead of interrupting or disagreeing directly, a well-timed question can gently bring the conversation back to the main point.
gently.zh: 与其直接打断或表示反对，一个切入时机恰当的问题可以温和地把对话拉回正题。

gently.en: The pot is never completely emptied. Instead, new ingredients and water are added when necessary and left simmering – cooking at a temperature just below boiling so that the food bubbles gently.
gently.zh: 锅里的东西从来没有完全清空过。相反，必要时会加入新的食材和水，并保持慢炖——在略低于沸点的温度下烹饪，让食物轻轻冒泡。

gently.en: The dream that these apps are selling is this: you'll be able to have a real spoken conversation with an AI, it will understand your accent, respond naturally, correct your mistakes gently, and you'll emerge more fluent.
gently.zh: 这些应用兜售的梦想是：你将能够与人工智能进行真正的口语对话，它会听懂你的口音、自然地回应、温和地纠正你的错误，然后你会变得更加流利。

geographical.en: OK, that's a wide geographical area. 27.5% Irish, Scottish and Welsh, but again, explicitly not English.
geographical.zh: 好吧，那是一个广阔的地理区域。27.5%属于爱尔兰、苏格兰和威士忌，不对，是苏格兰和威尔士，但同样明确指出不是英国。

geographical.en: Then, every eligible adult votes for the person they want in their constituency, in their geographical area.
geographical.zh: 然后，每个符合条件的成年人都会在他们所在的选区（即地理区域）投票给他们想要的人。

geographical.en: The Royal Geographical Society had its sights set on South America and proposed this as an option to Fawcett.
geographical.zh: 皇家地理学会将目光投向了南美洲，并向 Fawcett 提出了这个选项。

geographical.en: Your ' ethnicity',you would probably think of in geographical terms, maybe which continent or which region your 'people' came from.
geographical.zh: 至于你的“族群”（ethnicity），你可能会从地理角度来思考，也许是你的“族人”来自哪个大洲或哪个地区。

geographical.en: Now, you might think, “well, Turkey, or at least the geographical area of Turkey, does have a long and storied history.
geographical.zh: 现在，你可能会想，“嗯，土耳其，或者说土耳其的地理区域，确实有着悠久而传奇的历史。

geography.en: These cities are hemmed in by geography, and the most desirable areas are already built up.
geography.zh: 这些城市受地理条件限制，最理想的区域已经完全开发完毕了。

geography.en: Why move the capital from Rome? Once again, geography was probably the reason.
geography.zh: 为什么要将首都从罗马迁走？又一次，地理原因可能是罪魁祸首。

geography.en: And it's this question of geography which interested BBC presenter, Greg Foot.
geography.zh: 正是这个地理问题引起了BBC主持人格雷格·福特的兴趣。

geography.en: This division is not some ancient accident of geography.
geography.zh: 这种划分并非某种古老的地理偶然。

geography.en: Unless you have a particular passion for geography, this might not sound like the most interesting club in the world.
geography.zh: 除非你对地理有着特殊的热情，否则这听起来可能不是世界上最有趣的俱乐部。

generator.en: Trust us. Follow our instructions. The shock generator the teacher was shown looked convincing.
generator.zh: 相信我们，照我们说的做。“教师”看到的电击发生器，外观十分逼真可信。

generator.en: The electrodes were props. The shock generator was not connected to anything.
generator.zh: 电极只是道具，电击发生器根本没有接通任何东西。

generator.en: There are also image generators that can create pictures from words, and many companies are using AI to automate tasks that used to need people, like answering customer questions or analyzing data.
generator.zh: 还有能根据文字创作图片的图像生成器，许多公司正在使用AI来自动化那些原本需要人工来完成的任务，比如回答客户问题或分析数据。

genuine.en: The logic was that it needed to be a genuine deterrent, which only the truly destitute would turn to.
genuine.zh: 其逻辑在于，它需要成为一种真正的震慑，只有真正赤贫的人才会求助于它。

genuine.en: He becomes, by all accounts, a genuine farmer, someone who gets up early and knows his land and takes pride in it.
genuine.zh: 据各方说法，他成了一名真正的农民，一个起早贪黑、熟悉自己的土地并以此为荣的人。

genuine.en: France expanded its borders. It grew. Was this a genuine attempt to create equality, or was it just another form of colonialism?
genuine.zh: 法国扩大了它的边界。它壮大了。这究竟是真诚地试图创造平等，还是仅仅是另一种形式的殖民主义？

genuine.en: One is that it was some kind of tragic accident, either a genuine accident or some miscalculation by one of the guards.
genuine.zh: 一种猜测是，这是某种悲剧性的意外——要么是真正的事故，要么是某个看守的失误判断。

genuine.en: It had been drawn up as a genuine emergency plan to crush unrest or uprisings, and Hitler himself even signed off on it.
genuine.zh: 它是作为镇压骚乱或起义的真正紧急计划而起草的，希特勒本人甚至还签署批准了它。

gentle.en: They let us be more polite and perhaps gentle in our words.
gentle.zh: 它们让我们在言语上更加礼貌，或许也更温和。

gentle.en: And often, the partnership was neither gentle nor sentimental.
gentle.zh: 而且通常情况下，这种伙伴关系既不温柔，也不感性。

gentle.en: In American memory, he is a tyrant. In British popular culture, a figure of pity or of gentle comedy.
gentle.zh: 在美国人的记忆中，他是一个暴君。在英国大众文化中，他是一个令人同情或温和滑稽的人物。

gentle.en: During those long, haunted nights on the Western Front, his mind drifted back to the lush green canopy of South America, to the gentle currents of unknown rivers, and to the stories of that hidden city.
gentle.zh: 在西线战场那些漫长而挥之不去的夜晚里，他的思绪飘回了南美洲郁郁葱葱的绿色树冠、不知名河流的柔和水流，以及关于那座隐藏城市的种种传说。

genius.en: Ramanujan’s story reminds us that genius can come from the most unlikely places.
genius.zh: Ramanujan的故事提醒我们，天才可以来自最不可思议的地方。

genius.en: He proved that genius can exist in the most unexpected places.​
genius.zh: 事实证明，天才可以存在于最意想不到的地方。

genius.en: He became professionally isolated. He was excluded from the institutions that had once depended on his genius.
genius.zh: 他在职业上陷入孤立。他被排挤在曾经依赖他天才的机构之外。

genius.en: He was undoubtedly a genius. But what do you think?
genius.zh: 他无疑是一个天才。但你怎么看？

genius.en: We’ve talked so far about the genius of Alan Turing.
genius.zh: 到目前为止，我们一直在讨论 Alan Turing 的天才之处。

gentleman.en: And the general reaction is probably best summed up by the end of the clip, where an elderly gentleman commented, “one day you’re waking up and you cannae have a shower because there’s no water because it’s cooling down some computer somewhere”.
gentleman.zh: 片段结尾处的一位老绅士的评论大概最能总结大众的普遍反应，他评论道：“有一天你醒来，却没法洗澡了，因为没有水了，水都被拿去冷却某个地方的电脑了。”

geometry.en: And once the young man had mastered those, he would move on to the quadrivium: arithmetic, geometry, music, and astronomy.
geometry.zh: 一旦年轻人掌握了这些，他就会进入“四艺”：算术、几何、音乐和天文学。

generous.en: The generous young emperor, the son of Germanicus, the darling of Rome, seemed to vanish.
generous.zh: 那个慷慨的年轻皇帝、Germanicus 的儿子、罗马的宠儿，似乎消失了。

generous.en: In the case of Italy, the country has historically had very generous rules on citizenship by ancestry, by descent.
generous.zh: 就意大利而言，该国历史上对通过世袭、血统获得公民身份的规则一直非常宽容。

generous.en: The Italian state made a conscious choice to maintain legal ties to these people and their descendants, even generations later — hence the extremely generous rules on citizenship by descent.
generous.zh: 意大利政府有意识地选择与这些人及其后代保持法律联系，哪怕已经过了好几代人——这也是为什么通过血统获得公民身份的规则极其宽容的原因。

generous.en: But what you might also quite rightly point out is that this “living wage” must surely have been more generous than a modern “living wage”, given that it aims to support one non-working parent and three children.
generous.zh: 但你可能也会很正确地指出，这种“生活工资”肯定比现代的“生活工资”更慷慨，因为它旨在供养一名不工作的家长和三个孩子。
